name: Nazi Chic
summary: Nazi Chic refers to the appropriation of Nazi-era style, insignia, and paraphernalia within counterculture and popular fashion.
description: Nazi Chic refers to the appropriation of Nazi-era style, insignia, and paraphernalia within counterculture and popular fashion. This utilization is primarily employed for shock value , the transgression of social norms, or as a mechanism to critique contemporary society through historical allusion. The trend emerged in the mid-1970s alongside the London punk movement, subsequently proliferating into heavy metal , glam rock , and industrial subcultures, as well as the leather and bondage scenes. By the 21st century, the aesthetic gained a distinct depoliticized traction within certain Asian cultural contexts. [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Transgression, subversion , shock value , critique of authority, historical allusion (when used for commentary)
